scopeNote: The companion roster preserves qpdf, Ghostscript, MuPDF mutool, libpng pngfix, and WhatsApp JPEG Image Repair as direct-repair capability evidence and now labels them recovery-engine baselines rather than equivalent consumer browser experiences. Recoverit, R-Studio, and Recuva remain documented adjacent deleted-file or disk-recovery products.
purpose: Expand the direct-provider qualification beyond the two services that completed a fully scoreable six-case PDF workflow.
scoringRule: Only providers that accepted the frozen inputs and yielded downloadable, independently validatable full outputs are assigned exact-content recovery scores. Availability, upload interop, maintenance, demo placeholders, and paywalls are reported separately.

fullyScored.note: Two UI successes produced downloads, but neither matched the frozen page-render fingerprints.
